selection: quality, higher final bound, smaller gap, earlier non-root node, tree progress, work/wall
H0_gate: Neither primary reaches a confirmed non-root node within 450s and both spend >=80% of their actual wall at root.
telemetry: MIPNODE_NODCNT>0 confirms leaving root; sparse observations are carried forward only with their timestamp/age. Missing phase evidence remains null; FINAL state is recorded separately from 600s observations.
H0_limits: Heuristics=0 leaves node probing and other internal root processing uncontrolled. The goal is useful B&B/global-bound progress and P1 quality, not attribution to an internal routine.
